description: Bounded sandbox-first scope split from T7-TTS-001. Execute the pinned Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 0.6B candidate on clay-direct-dev and measure model load, local inference, complete generated PCM/waveform availability, realtime factor, resource use and output identity using an in-memory/file/null sink. Current official Qwen3TTSModel wrapper/source returns completed talker-code lists and completed wav arrays; non_streaming_mode=false is documented as simulation rather than true streaming generation. Therefore true incremental first-PCM TTFA and mid-generation producer cancellation remain zero unless a distinct incremental lower-level API is separately executed. Output-adapter/sink cancellation using the real generated waveform may be measured separately inside the system Voice-Slice. A physical speaker remains outside this semantic objective; T7-TTS-001 remains authoritative for audible/heard/cancellation-to-physical-silence S4 evidence.
